title: Zero Flag Unit
statement: Design a zero flag unit that asserts when an 8-bit value is zero. This unit is a datapath status generator used in branch and condition evaluation. The output should be combinational and instantaneous with input changes.
behavior: No sequential elements may be used.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use registers or flip-flops.
hint: Compare all bits to zero at once.
